address: GF, North Esplanade, Wynn Palace, Avenida da Nave Desportiva, Cotai, Macau
bio: As well as the main menu, the dining concept by chef Tam Kwok-Fung features two sets – one classic, one seasonal. New à la carte items pop up every month to showcase seasonal ingredients. The traditional appetiser ge zha, or deep-fried egg custard, comes in a hairy crab version in autumn - the velvety custard bursting with crabmeat flavour is enrobed in a crispy crust. Barbecued pork belly glazed with honey is smoky and aromatic....
